question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer

question: List the names of all media types.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: How many tracks are longer than 10 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 600000

question: Which countries do our customers come from? Return each distinct country once.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer

question: What is the total of all invoices ever issued, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice

question: How many employees have the title 'Sales Support Agent'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent'

question: Return each genre name with its number of tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) FROM Genre g LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

question: Which 5 artists have the most albums? Return artist name and album count.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: Total invoice revenue per billing country, rounded to 2 decimals. Return country and revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: What was the total invoice revenue in 2013, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2013'

question: How many tracks are on the album 'Let There Be Rock'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: Which customers (first name, last name) live in Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: For each employee who is a support rep, how many customers do they support? Return the employee's first name, last name and customer count.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName

question: What is the average track length in minutes for each media type? Return media type name and average minutes rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0, 2) FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent? Return first name, last name and total spent rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which genre generated the most revenue from invoice lines (unit price times quantity)? Return genre name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS rev FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which sales support agent generated the most invoice revenue from the customers they support? Return first name, last name and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS rev FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks have never been purchased?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InvoiceLine il WHERE il.TrackId = t.TrackId)

question: Monthly invoice revenue for 2012: return the month as YYYY-MM and revenue rounded to 2 decimals, in month order.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2012' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

question: Which playlist contains the most tracks? Return playlist name and track count. (If several playlists share a name, treat each playlist separately.)
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of artists that have at least one track in the 'Jazz' genre, with how many Jazz tracks each has, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz' GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY n DESC

question: Which employees report directly to the General Manager? Return their first and last names.
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.Title = 'General Manager'
